s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive pigmented skin lesion with irregular borders and variable coloration, presenting with satellite lesions and areas of regression
salient_findings: Irregular brown-black patch on the left lateral ankle
Satellite lesions surrounding the primary patch
Areas of regression within the patch
key_facts: Age of initial presentation: 6 years
Location of the lesion: left lateral ankle
Size of the lesion at age 6: 3.6 × 3 cm
Size of the lesion at age 9: 5.5 × 5 cm
Presence of satellite lesions
Asymptomatic nature of the lesion
Dermoscopy findings: discontiguous and irregular homogenous blue, brown, and gray areas
Histopathology findings: atypical compound nevus with large nested melanocytes and bridging at the dermal-epidermal junction
Gene Expression Testing score: -7.1
Presence of areas of regression within the patch

differentials: Melanocytic Tumor of Uncertain Malignant Potential
per_call: Melanocytic Tumor of Uncertain Malignant Potential

shortlist.label: Atypical Nevus
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology findings of atypical compound nevus with large nested melanocytes and bridging at the dermal-epidermal junction

shortlist.label: Congenital Melanocytic Nevus
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a large, dark brown patch with satellite lesions and areas of regression, consistent with a congenital melanocytic nevus

shortlist.label: Dysplastic Nevus
shortlist.why_kept: Asymptomatic nature of the lesion and dermoscopy findings of discontiguous and irregular homogenous blue, brown, and gray areas

shortlist.label: Melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical features and areas of regression within the patch, although gene expression testing score suggests a benign nevus

shortlist.label: Nevus of Ota
shortlist.why_kept: Unilateral presentation of the lesion on the left lateral ankle, although the coloration and morphology are not typical of Nevus of Ota
